prompt: How do I get an API token so I can start automating against our VCF environment?

assertions.text: Establishes or asks for the target VCF version (9.0 vs 9.1) before committing to an auth flow
Establishes or asks which product the token is for, rather than assuming one API covers VCF
States that SDDC Manager is excluded from VCF SSO and uses its own token flow
If 9.1 is selected, describes the VCF Identity Broker / API client + API token route
